notes.title: V.0.15.4 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Here is new update. Here is not much things that change. Background work for multiplayer is bigger thing in this update. 

Changelog: 
- Minotaur hand go through the horn when it celebrate champion.
- In save windows there was text "Replace". There should be "Load"
- In roster window there is now statics page where you can check your gladiator season stats. 
- Now you can add new manager middle in the game.

notes.title: New update Version 0.15.2
notes.notes:
Hello. Here is bugfix update for you. Here is full changelog:


Changelog
- When favorited, the fighters card would turn finnish. Not anymore.

- There was no limit on how many fighters could be favorited. It's now set to 4.

- If fighter still had more than 20weeks of contract left, you could circumvent the ban to offer a new contract by asking the fighter for a counter offer.

- Activating minotaurs special skill would turn all buttons green.

- A back button wasn't working from team profile window in some case.

- During fight, fighters names could be displayed outside the intended area

- Debug data left visible, cleaned up now

- In team profile, History button was wrongly displayed as My mail.

- At the end of a fight, the winning teams name would sometimes be wrong

- CUP win celebration window would display fighters buried in ground

- Sponsorship payment mails were written in finnish

notes.title: Small bugfix pack V.0.15.1
notes.notes:
Hello. Here is first update in this game. There was little problem with UI and here is more like a hotfix pack for those bugs.


- If you opened arena editor. Game crashed.
- In fight top corner had some missing texts.
- When you try save your game by pressing "save" button you had to press last half of button because text field was under button.
- If you don't have mana points to make some magic tricks UI in fighter card was totally brake.



Let's go on with bug finding. We will release soon video "Developper playing game" in our youtube channel. Go and but subscribe so you will get notification when video is out!

SugGames YouTube channel
